SELECT pp.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, pp.PRODUCT_TYPE AS productType, SUM( CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(p.PAYMENT_DATE, 'YYYYMM') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') THEN TO_NUMBER(p.PAYMENT_PAY) ELSE 0 END ) AS monthlySalesAmount, SUM(TO_NUMBER(p.PAYMENT_PAY)) AS totalSalesAmount, SUM( CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(p.PAYMENT_DATE, 'YYYYMM') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMM') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS monthlySalesCount, COUNT(*) AS totalSalesCount FROM PAYMENT p JOIN PAYMENT_PRODUCT pp ON p.PRODUCT_NO = pp.PRODUCT_NO WHERE p.STATUS = 'A' GROUP BY pp.PRODUCT_NAME, pp.PRODUCT_TYPE ORDER BY pp.PRODUCT_NAME
